title: Decisions API Read-only Shadow Comparison
required_previous_checkpoint: accepted 0.1.2 stable realtime mini voice architecture (repair6-repair15)
scope: Opt-in extra-cost text-only Decisions route classification in Python host, compared to Realtime Mini with zero routing authority; all voice/wake/sleep/audio behavior kept unchanged.
decision_authority: Realtime Mini overlap only; Decisions shadows are logged, never acted upon.
known_limitations: The 20-case standalone benchmark agreement was 90% and its labels are synthetic, not validated production truth.
Decisions accepts transcript text, so end-to-end latency including transcript availability is not established.
Decisions results may be canceled and unavailable if the session ends quickly (especially sleep).
No actual Luna/actions are executed in mini-overlap.
The shadow adds billable input-token costs and additional transcript processing.
No automatic switch-over or fallback routing is implemented.
live_acceptance: pending Windows shadow voice testing; do not clean or commit until accepted
